title: A.e. existence and Borel measurability of the density (Simon Lemma 8.3.6)
statement: (Simon Ch. 8, Lemma 3.6; exactly the contract Prop DensityExistsAE.) For all N, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^N and every n-varifold V on U with locally bounded first variation in U, there is a Borel measurable Θ : ℝ^N → [0,∞] such that for μ_V-a.e. x: Θ(x) ≠ ∞ and HasDensity n μ_V x (Θ x), i.e. densityRatio n μ_V x ρ = μ_V(closedBall x ρ)/(ω_n·ofReal(ρ)^n) → Θ(x) as ρ ↓ 0 (μ_V = V.weight, ω_n = unitBallVolume n).
